Free Pinterest Pin Title and Description Checker

By Marie Glow StudioUpdated September 23, 2026

Title preview (shaded text is past the first 40 characters)

    Limits come from Pinterest’s Help Center: titles up to 100 characters (about the first 40 are most likely to show) and descriptions up to 500. The keyword checks are Marie Glow Studio guidelines, not Pinterest rules. Nothing you type leaves your browser.

    How to use this checker

    Type the phrase you want the pin to be found for, then write your title and description. The counters and checks update as you type. Fix anything marked with a cross first, then work through the warnings.

    What the checks mean

    • 100 character title limit. This is a Pinterest limit. Anything over it will not fit.
    • First 40 characters. Pinterest says roughly the first 40 characters of a title are the part most likely to show to people. That is why the preview shades everything after it. Lead with the words a searcher would type.
    • 500 character description limit. Also a Pinterest limit. You do not have to use all of it.
    • Keyword placement. This is a guideline from how Pinterest search works, not a rule. Pinterest reads the words on your pin to understand it, so the exact phrase belongs in the title and early in the description. Our guides on writing SEO friendly pin titles and writing pin descriptions go deeper.

    What a checker cannot tell you

    A tool can count characters and spot where a phrase sits. It cannot tell you whether you picked the right keyword, whether the image matches the search, or whether the pin points to the right page. That is the work of keyword research and a proper account review.

    If you would like the whole account looked at instead of one pin at a time, the Pinterest SEO Audit reviews your profile, boards, pins and keywords and gives you a ranked 30 day plan.

    Frequently asked questions

    How long can a Pinterest pin title be?

    Up to 100 characters, according to Pinterest’s Help Center. Roughly the first 40 characters are the part most likely to show to people, so put the important words first.

    How long can a Pinterest pin description be?

    Up to 500 characters. You do not need to fill it. Write natural sentences that say what the pin is about and include your main keyword early.

    Does this tool store what I type?

    No. The checker runs in your browser and nothing you type is sent or saved.

    Is a hashtag list better than a sentence?

    Natural sentences with your keyword are the guideline we recommend. A wall of hashtags gives Pinterest less to understand than a clear description does.
